text.en:
The first paragraph of Section 2 of Executive Order No. 12 series of 2001, as
amended by Executive Order No. 327 (series of 2004) is hereby further amended to read as
"Composition. -The Commission shall be composed of a
Chairperson and four (4) Commissioners to be appointed by
the President. All members of the Commission shall serve on a
full-time basis and at least three (3) of them shall be members of
the Philippine Bar.

All orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with
this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or otherwise modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall lake effect immediately upon publication in a
newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 18 t hof January, 2008.
Thain the every
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
